bio: Welcome to Harvard! My name is Hector, and I’m from the beautiful state of California. I have a BA from UC Santa Cruz (go Banana Slugs!), an MTS from Harvard Divinity School, and I recently completed an EdM from the Harvard Graduate School of Education, where I studied education leadership and entrepreneurship. I’m passionate about higher education, especially student well-being and success. I support student success efforts across Harvard and work closely with students from underrepresented backgrounds. In my free time, I love working out, watching movies and TV shows, making playlists on Spotify, and playing video games. I’m excited to meet you all!
